collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager plans a grand public proposal at the festival: do it in public, or ask in private first.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) wants to propose to (friend) at the harvest festival, in front of everyone, with a song and a carved bowl. (friend)'s friend has warned (subject) that (friend) hates being the center of attention. (subject) has already told the drummers. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The drums stop, (subject) sings, and every eye turns to (friend), who turns bright red and stares at the ground. There is a terrible pause. Then (friend) whispers yes, and the village roars. Afterwards, (friend) tells (subject) never to do that to (friend.him/her) again. (subject) promises.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) asks (friend) privately, on the walk to the festival. (friend) says yes. Then (subject) says (subject.he/she) had planned a song and a big public moment, and (friend) laughs so hard (friend.he/she) has to sit down, and says (friend.he/she) loves (subject.him/her) for not doing it. They announce it quietly at the end of the night.
